name: campus-navigation-system
description: Unified startup workflow for Campus Navigation System

scripts.start: concurrently -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue" -n "backend,consumer,ai,frontend" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:consumer" "npm run start:ai" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../ai-services && .\venv\Scripts\pip.exe install -r requirements.txt
